segments.text: Priya Sharma: The database schema migration deadline has been moved from August 29th to next Monday, September 1st due to the team being short-staffed this week.
Rahul Verma: I investigated the Redis timeout issue. The root cause is incorrect connection pool sizing. We are changing the max connections from 10 to 50.
Alex Rivera: We decided to use Docker Compose for local development environments. The decision was made to avoid Kubernetes complexity at this stage.
Nisha Patel: I will own the NLP pipeline integration task. I commit to delivering the entity extractor prototype by end of sprint, which is September 5th.
